message:
Hi) I’d like to order one Igbo video from you. Could we agree on $40 for 1 video, with the deadline being today or tomorrow?

I’ll send you all the details now.
Hello, good evening

I can have the video delivered tomorrow.
The price for 1 video is $55
ok) i make offer
Yes
I’ve attached a copy of the file for you to preview. If you’re happy with it, I’ll provide a high-resolution version without the watermark.
Hello) thank you. I’ve submitted it for verification and will write to you again afterward.
Alright
Hello) could you please record it once more? You said that part slightly out of context. You need to say: Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a

Hello) could you please re-record it? You said something that was not in the text. You need to say: "One person wrote to me, такое сообщение (starts to read the сообщение с телефон):
"I'm constantly losing, it seems to me that something is wrong with the game" Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a
Can you reschedule for tomorrow?
Hello
Yes
Hello) could you please let me know whether the video is ready?
I’ll forward it to you soon.
Find attached a corrected copy

Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! - could you read this phrase from the phone) At the beginning, you translated or pronounced it a little poorly. It is very important that this message be read correctly from the phone, while everything else should follow the script exactly as written) could you please record it again
Hello)
Here’s an updated copy
Please be aware that, when translated into Igbo, the wording in the script goes beyond the 50-60secs duration. As a result, reading the precise actions carried out in the game

"Someone sent me a message." (Begins reading the message from the phone.)
"I’m always losing. It seems like there is something wrong with the game." -Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a!
(Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! — translation of the message.)
The actor begins to respond:
"You most likely downloaded a fake version in which winning is impossible!
I’ll show you what the fake version looks like.
Let’s play here and see.
The graphics seem unusual.
Look, we’ve played.
We lose straight away, correct?
That is the fake version.
Now we’ll launch the real app.
Let’s play here for a bit.
My bet is already placed — €10, okay?
You can see that the graphics here are different.
One more step... excellent.
€732.
I personally controlled each step.
Let’s withdraw the money now.
After waiting briefly, the winning confirmation will show up here.
The money is already in my account.
Look, I’ve already received a notification from my banking app.
That’s everything.
Do you see?
It took only a few minutes.
It really is that easy.
This is why many people use fake apps and ultimately lose their money.
Use the link below the video to download only the official app, and make money the same way I do."
Here is the script) You said it incorrectly again in the video, and you need to begin this way, please) Read it closely and say everything exactly as it appears in the script.
You keep altering the introduction script.
Compare the first line here with the one you just sent; they are not the same.
No) look, they are the same) I sent you the complete script because you are not speaking clearly from it.
Watch the video; I read it from the phone.

Hello, good morning.
Please explain exactly what you don’t like.
Could you identify the lines that did not sound clear?
Hello) yes, I’ll write it out for you now.

Ana m efunahụ ego mgbe niile, ọ dị m ka ihe adịghị mma na egwuregwu a! - you need to read this from the phone at the beginning, acting as though you are reading a message on the same phone you will use to show and play the game) After that, you must say everything exactly as written in the script) could you please reshoot it? I really need the video today.
Yes
Hi, please review the final take.
I’ve submitted it for review and will contact you again afterward.
You say that someone sent you this message, but you also need to say aloud what the message contains. I’m writing the sentence here; please say it in the video:
Ego na-efunahụ m mgbe niile, ọ dịkwa m ka e nwere ihe na-adịghị mma n'egwuregwu a!
Although I can now see that you did say it, so I suppose my translation is poor.
I did say it in the video.
Yes I did.
yes yes
Why are you still asking for the same thing?
No, no) I submitted it for verification and am waiting for the customer to respond,

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],
I haven’t received any feedback from you yet.
Hello) sorry, I’m still waiting for an answer from the customer.

Hello) unfortunately, you again delivered the script in a way that does not match the text. There is no time left for another reshoot, so could I please cancel this contract) The video was not completed correctly.
Was the text vetted by the same person?
Because I spent time and resources on this job, and I delivered it according to the script.
Yes) it was the same person. You said the beginning poorly again, and that part is very important in the script. You need to say everything exactly as the script states.
Unfortunately, I need to cancel the offer because your video will not be used, and there is no time available to reshoot it.
Igbo is my mother tongue, and it was spoken correctly.
Sure do
